paragraphs: Menashi of Biri of Naresh. His son Rav Giddel — [Yoma 81b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.81b.11).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied body has מבירי, while the catalog label has מכירי. Yoma 81b in the William Davidson Edition – Vocalized Aramaic has מִבֵּירֵי דְנַרֶשׁ, supporting the place construction “from Beirei of Naresh,” rather than “who was expounded.” The source’s Menashi form is retained.

The linked Bavli names Rav Giddel bar Menashe of Beirei of Naresh, and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=858&lang=en) cites this same folio. Hyman’s short headword notice gives Menashi and then names his son.
